The bubble exhibits strong iridescence with swirling blue, pink, and gold patterns on its surface. It reflects the surrounding environment, showing distorted shapes and colors. The background is out of focus (bokeh), featuring dark tones and hints of red and blue structures. There is visible text in the bottom right corner.
